summary: Co-occurrence and naturalisation proxies (sPlotOpen, GloNAF, GIFT, a Dryad Darwin's-naturalization study) and relatedness covariates are open, but no repository table of pairwise competition coefficients indexed by genus was found, and GloBI has no competition interaction type.
next_step: Assemble competition coefficients from published pairwise-experiment supplements (e.g. Violle, Cahill, Germain studies named by assessors) with genus and phylogenetic distance, or pre-register a co-occurrence/naturalisation proxy test on GloNAF + sPlotOpen with matched non-congeneric pairs.
obstacles_confirmed: Experimental competition coefficients for congeneric versus non-congeneric pairs were not found in any queried repository.
Co-occurrence is confounded by habitat filtering (not resolved by any dataset found).
